findings.text: drafts/routes.ts:273-277: retried line create returns 200 before the converted check, so a retry after conversion gets 200 (no data harm)
convert.ts:60-70: fallbacks '' and 'weight' for newName/newKind are unreachable today but would create an empty-named ingredient; check in draftMissing or throw

data: draft name and newName allow 80 chars but products/ingredients cap at 60 (products/routes.ts:26, ingredients/routes.ts:35); convert creates rows the APIs would refuse. Cap at 60 and add the length check to createProductRow/createIngredientRow, with tests

money: convert.ts:61-68 reuses a same-name ingredient with a different mode (new line volume ml vs existing weight g), silently wrong cost. Refuse with a clear code (e.g. draft_ingredient_mode_mismatch) naming the line; phone shows it

money: mobile estimate.ts:39,52-57 counts a draft line that is also a default ingredient twice (convert uses the draft amount once), and a deleted existing ingredient costs 0 instead of no estimate; align with convert
convert.ts:86 merged amount of existing+reused line can exceed MAX_LINE_AMOUNT
converted drafts can't be deleted and GET /drafts is unbounded
mobile convert: a lost reply then 409 draft_converted shows an error instead of refreshing and linking the product
convert.ts:68-84 reused same-name ingredient keeps its own price; draft purchase price dropped silently; check A8 shows 'dùng lại' clearly (by hand)
routes.ts L343-406: a done draft can become incomplete after edits and stays done; convert still refuses with draft_incomplete
projects/routes.ts pricedDrafts counts converted drafts, so one converted priced draft locks the currency for good (converted drafts can't be deleted)
routes.ts L216-237: a refused done rolls back other fields sent in the same request (phone sends status separately)
draft_ingredient_mode_mismatch is not in spec R7; add it to the spec

routes.ts L272-349: line create didn't reopen a done draft (fixed in the same pass, test added)
routes.ts L281-285: line-create retry returns 200 without comparing the body (harmless for UUID offline queue)
